note: The rule values a club battle is fought by: per-keyword attack, defence, full-scale threshold, ability and material yields; the practice opponents' club, level, vitality, energy, speed and deck; which opponents stand at each rung of a club's ladder; the club-skill effect rows and the skill-book recipes. Integers and table keys only -- the opponents' names are not here, because nothing in server/ reads them. An operator may put a file of the same shape at runtime/clubbattle.json (or point TMO_CLUB_DATA at one); rows there win on the key and new rows are added.
